subject.title: perf(ui): flip sessions instantly and drop redundant switch RPCs

question: Should this large session-switch optimization land as one change after focused review of stale-route and overlapping-subscription behavior, or should those lifecycle changes be split into narrower follow-up PRs?
rationale: The protected maintainer label and the cross-cutting session-state changes require owner judgment about acceptable lifecycle complexity; source context alone does not establish that product and maintenance tradeoff.

options.title: Review and land as one change
options.body: Keep the coordinated performance work together after confirming route cleanup, subscription generation ordering, and completed UI checks.

options.title: Split lifecycle changes
options.body: Land the navigation and cache improvements separately if maintainers prefer independent review and rollback boundaries for subscription overlap.

recommendation.title: Review and land as one change
recommendation.body: Keep the coordinated performance work together after confirming route cleanup, subscription generation ordering, and completed UI checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both this PR and the adjacent merged Control UI session-loading optimization, making them the strongest available routing candidate.
